List can expand or shrink during the program execution. This is what makes it ideal for managing changing data in real-time.

You can insert a value shown.



To add to the end of the list, you can use one of the followings:



You can also remove an item as shown. If you try to remove value at an invalid index or when the list is empty, the program will crash.




You are simulating a mini piggy bank that can store up to 3 coins using a list.

                       

The list starts empty and uses D22 to add a coin and D24 to remove one. You cannot add more than 3 coins or remove a coin if the list is empty. A sample execution is shown below.


Display, Add, Remove, do one function at a time.
